t: Free control software that runs K40, GRBL, and other laser cutters.
steps: Download a release build or install it with pip install meerk40t[all].
Ask IT to approve the install.
Confirm that your laser model is supported.
Review laser safety rules with an adult trained on the machine.
Connect the laser and open the software.
Load a simple shape and run a test on scrap material.
Keep the machine supervised at all times.
